identity_dispositions.name: τ0-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
identity_dispositions.displacement_case: Can plausibly displace a retained long-horizon hierarchical manipulation comparator because it combines memory-augmented high-level subtask generation with world-model-guided test-time search and released executable components.

identity_dispositions.name: OneTwoVLA: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Adaptive Reasoning
identity_dispositions.displacement_case: Can plausibly displace a retained reasoning-augmented manipulation comparator because one policy adaptively switches between reasoning and acting and is evaluated on long-horizon planning, recovery, interaction, and visual grounding.

identity_dispositions.name: Xiaomi-Robotics-0: An Open-Sourced Vision-Language-Action Model with Real-Time Execution
identity_dispositions.displacement_case: Can plausibly displace a retained real-time or resource-constrained VLA comparator because it explicitly targets asynchronous low-latency execution while providing pretrained and benchmark-specific weights plus post-training code.
